figures.finding: Civil majority in Burkina Faso is eighteen under the new Code des personnes et de la famille (loi 012-2025/ALT, adopted 1 September 2025), which aligned the age of marriage and of civil majority at eighteen; the 1989 code had set it at twenty.

figures.finding: The general minimum age for employment is sixteen (Labour Code, article 152); light work is allowed from thirteen to sixteen under the 2023 order, at most four and a half hours a day and fourteen a week, never in school time, on Sundays or holidays, or between 8 p.m. and 8 a.m.

laws: Loi n° 028-2008/AN portant Code du travail, art. 152

figures.applies: All employment. The 2023 order's list of permitted light work (art. 12) names agriculture, livestock farming, fishing, domestic work, handicrafts and informal trade, not performing work. Both sources are secondary: the Labour Code's PDF and the order's page on gov.bf hosts reset the connection from this environment.

they may be performed by children aged between 13 and 16 (article 2), they are prohibited during school or vocational training periods, on Sundays, public holidays or days declared to be non-working days with pay, and between 8 p.m. and 8 a.m. (articles 4 and 6). Light work may be performed by children aged between 13 and 16 for a maximum of 4 and a half hours per day, without exceeding 14 hours per week (article 7).
the Labour Code sets the minimum age for admission to employment at 16

figures.finding: In Burkina Faso, as in every OHADA state, a minor may hold shares in a company where liability stops at the contribution (a SARL, an SA or SAS, or as a limited partner) but cannot be a partner liable for the company's debts beyond it, and cannot trade unless emancipated; the Uniform Act sets no age of its own for a SARL's manager, who must be a natural person, so a manager's capacity is the national civil law's (majority or emancipation).

figures.applies: Burkina Faso is a state party to the OHADA Treaty (named in the 2008 treaty's preamble), whose Uniform Acts are directly applicable there, notwithstanding domestic law (art. 10). A minor's shares are subscribed through the legal administrator.

sources.said: Les mineurs et les majeurs incapables ne peuvent être associés d’une société dans laquelle ils seraient tenus des dettes sociales au‐delà de leurs apports.
La société à responsabilité limitée est gérée par une ou plusieurs personnes physiques, associées ou non.
Le mineur, sauf s'il est émancipé, ne peut avoir la qualité de commerçant ni effectuer des actes de commerce.
Les actes uniformes sont directement applicables et obligatoires dans les Etats-Parties, nonobstant toute disposition contraire de droit interne, antérieure ou postérieure.
